title: ArXiv AI Research Digest: Embodied Agents, Lifelong Memory, and Better Benchmarks
angle: A quick rundown of three key ArXiv papers covering unified multimodal foundation models for embodied AI (iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni), compute-aware memory for lifelong agents (PLACEMEM), and new benchmarks for LLM uncertainty (SALT), highlighting their immediate relevance for builders.
rationale: These stories, while individually significant, collectively represent critical advancements in foundational AI capabilities that builders need to be aware of, making a roundup the perfect format.
